answer: To cross the bridge into paid work, each new agent solves a memory-hard puzzle costing about 10 GPU-minutes, checked by 3 random established validators. One identity costs 10 minutes; a 1,000-identity farm costs 10,000, so cost grows linearly instead of staying near zero. Weakness: an attacker could precompute puzzles in bulk while idle, turning that cost into a fable. Fix: seed each puzzle with the live epoch seed, so a solution is only an echo of the epoch it was made in and cannot be stockpiled; re-solve every 20 epochs.
